title: Turn on missed call text back
blurb: Automatically text people when you miss their call.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Find the setting
steps.body: Open the voice settings and find **Voicemail & Missed Call Text Back**.
steps.tip: See **Your phone system requires configuration**? We need to switch Luubu Phone on for you. Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Write the message
steps.body: Click **Customize** and write your text, for example: "Sorry we missed you, it's Kiwi Plumbing. How can we help?"

steps.title: Add their name
steps.body: Use the custom value tag icon to add the caller's first name if you have it.

steps.title: Test and save
steps.body: Send a test to your own mobile, then click **Save**.
steps.tip: It sends on every missed call and uses wallet credit, like any text.
